gate.public_gate: All quality and reliability gates plus a tested Linux host, authentication/abuse budget, license/publication decision and hosting account/budget qualification. Local success alone does not qualify a public service.
gate.scope: Previously published development/regression cases, not a new held-out research result. Generated scenarios include real prior generated assistant replies; no answers are substituted. Repeat the full refusal history with three generated math follow-ups. The owned model has a separate byte/role transport and cannot be treated as a matched pretrained comparison.
gate.scoring: Frozen literal expectations: exact/instruction require exact text; factual/correction/recall require the literal answer and absence of obsolete value; numeric math/refusal require the expected standalone number without an online-access refusal. Unknown and natural-chat probes use the predeclared phrase rules. Phrase scores are proxies and raw responses must be reviewed.

scope: Existing local Ollama service; no downloads or training.
